input: Track all household subscriptions in one spreadsheet

gold.taskTitle: Track All Household Subscriptions in One Spreadsheet
gold.taskDescription: Build a single spreadsheet that consolidates and tracks every household subscription in one place.

questions.title: Which spreadsheet tool will you use for this?
questions.description: Identify the platform the user wants to build the tracker in, such as Google Sheets, Excel, or Notion.

questions.title: What types of subscriptions need to be tracked?
questions.description: Determine the categories involved, such as streaming services, software, magazines, meal kits, or utilities.

questions.title: Do you have a rough count of current subscriptions?
questions.description: Understand the scale of the task to gauge how many entries the spreadsheet needs to accommodate.

questions.title: Which specific details must each subscription row include?
questions.description: Clarify what columns matter most to the user, such as cost, renewal date, billing cycle, payment method, or login info.

questions.title: Should the spreadsheet alert you before a renewal date?
questions.description: Find out if the user wants automated reminders or conditional formatting tied to upcoming renewal dates.

questions.title: Will multiple household members need access to this?
questions.description: Determine if the spreadsheet needs to be shared, and with whom, which affects platform choice and permissions.

questions.title: Is there a total monthly budget figure you want to monitor?
questions.description: Establish whether the user wants a running cost summary or a budget cap visually highlighted in the tracker.
